title: Knowledge-Augmented Log Anomaly Detection with Large Language Models
summary: The original LogPipe pipeline performs knowledge-augmented log anomaly detection by retrieving structured knowledge templates and injecting them into an LLM prompt to classify log blocks as normal or anomalous across multiple production-system datasets.
This reproduction replaces that knowledge-augmented pipeline with a direct LLM classification prompt over stratified samples of log blocks from each dataset.

dataset.name: BGL, Spirit, Thunderbird, HDFS, Hadoop2, Hadoop3, Spark2, Spark3 (last 20% test split)
